summary: The exact-count repeat_n_ implementation accepted successful child parses that consumed no input, accumulating repeated outputs at the same position. The fix compares eof_offset before and after each successful parse and invokes ErrMode::assert when no progress occurs. A verbatim reversal is identifiable, but no detecting upstream test was found at this commit: the fix adds no tests, existing empty-parser tests exercise unbounded repetition, and exact-count tests use consuming parsers or zero repetitions. Leave this candidate blocked for lack of a detecting upstream test; no tests were executed.
